summary: VERDICT: REOPEN (recorded as FAIL per tool's PASS|FAIL contract). Independently confirmed as real and correctly wired: (1) CRITICAL role-slug super_admin escalation fix (assertSlugNotReserved in rbac-admin.service.ts, called from createRole+duplicateRole; assertCanAssignRole in users.service.ts orders ('tenant_id' IS NULL) DESC so the global row wins slug collisions) -- matches claim exactly. (2) Billing invoice-webhook concurrency fix (billing-enforcement.service.ts activateTenant/startPaymentGrace WHERE status_changed_at guard, wired from billing.service.ts onPaymentSucceeded/onPaymentFailed via eventCreatedAtSec, plus isStaleInvoiceEvent pre-check) -- matches claim exactly. (3) Backend suite independently re-run: 285/285 suites, 2529/2529 tests PASS, exit 0. tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --noEmit: PASS (0 errors). eslint src --quiet: PASS (0 errors). (4) git status: all 60 dirty files spot-checked (6 of 60) are pure PT-PT->PT-BR spelling fixes, no logic changes; no new dependency/ORM/state-mgmt changes in the audit-fix commit range. (5) No real committed secrets found in the last 40 commits -- only local/ephemeral docker test credentials inside .claude/ops/evidence/*.json command logs. (6) Spot-checked 3 DIVIDA_ACEITA findings (fb500fee, 3efacceb, e3bd3754) -- all justifications accurate. (7) Tenant isolation spot-checked on 5 modules not named in the brief (contacts, licensing, financial-categories, contract-templates, marketing-campaign-builder) -- all correctly scoped by tenant_id. (8) No second ORM/competing state-mgmt/parallel migration mechanism introduced. HOWEVER: found a NEW authorization gap not covered by either prior cross-review pass -- find-e0b57623 (HIGH): RbacAdminService.duplicateRole copies a source role's entire role_permissions set without assertPermission's is_assignable check (unlike grant()) and hardcodes the new role's isAssignable:true regardless of the source role's own is_assignable flag -- including for the global is_system super_admin role, reachable via GET /rbac/roles and duplicable by a tenant owner (assertHierarchy passes). This defeats the ROLE-level is_assignable=false protection through a different channel than the slug collision just fixed, is uncovered by any existing spec, and was missed by both prior independent cross-reviews. Blast radius is currently bounded (no cross-tenant/platform-only permission exists in ROLE_PERMISSIONS today; RolesGuard still fail-closes write routes lacking @RequireRole) but it is a confirmed, code-grounded authorization-control gap on the exact surface this mission's CRITICAL fix targeted and must be closed (duplicateRole must call assertPermission per copied grant and must not force isAssignable:true when source.is_assignable is false) before this mission closes as done.
